craft_notes: Sthāyin: crown — anupāya recognition. Sanskrit-first: giant compound unpacked across line 1 (dawn-rays-flood). Rows: 4. Close: home forever. Rejected: translating garbhita as pregnant — killed: register clash; world-within keeps the womb-sense. Read aloud: arrival cadence — flood crests, ladder falls, home holds.

lines: Sun-steeped in dawn on dawn, one with Bhairava's flooding,
he lets the last ladder fall and comes home forever — the whole world within him.

reads_against.argmap: Ray-flooded Bhairava-state, means dropped, eternal entry into the all-containing self.
c1_essence: Crown: ray-flooded Bhairava-state, means-independence, eternal entry into the universe-wombed self.
